identity_anchors: Winking expression (one eye open, one closed)
Peace sign (V-sign) hand gesture near the eye
miHoYo text logo at the bottom
must_preserve: The specific facial layout: large open blue eye on left, winking eye on right
The hand gesture framing the right side of the face
The white/silver hair color and bangs structure
The 'miHoYo' logotype text at the bottom banner
The four-pointed star shape (can be stylized but must remain a 4-point star)
can_restyle: Line art thickness and color (can match theme)
Background elements (stars, sparkles can be thematic)
The yellow flower accessory (can be swapped for thematic element if needed, but face is priority)
The dark blue collar/clothing area (can be adapted to theme colors)
must_not_replace_with: Generic anime girl without specific Paimon features
Abstract symbols or logos replacing the character
color_preservation: Must retain the high-key lighting with dominant whites/creams for hair and skin. The deep blue/purple of the open eye and the specific navy blue of the collar are critical brand identifiers. The 'miHoYo' text should remain white on a dark background for legibility.
structure_summary: Close-up portrait composition focusing on the upper face. Asymmetrical balance with the hand gesture on the right. The head is framed by white hair, with a distinct V-shape formed by the fingers near the temple. A horizontal band at the bottom anchors the composition with the company logo.
risk_notes: Removing the 'miHoYo' text might make it look like fan art rather than the official app icon.
Changing the eye color (e.g., to red or green) breaks the character identity immediately.
Over-stylizing the face to the point where the wink and peace sign are lost will result in a generic avatar.
